main_text.head: TYPOGRAPHI LECTORI.

p.i: Omnes eodem cogimur: omnium Versatur urna: serius ocyus Sors exitura.

main_text.p: sic enim voluit Summus ille Optimus.
Cæterum hisce (studiose Lector) bene & diu fruere, ac tanti Viri posthumo fœtui typographisque favore ne dedigneris.

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout. The first lines are set in italic and are transcribed as printed; the word "omnium" is set on its own indented line and is treated as part of the first verse line. The catchword "FLO-" is a printed catchword at the lower right.
